title: Map planting
description: A map's planting plan beside its layout: <maps>/<id>/plants.json. The editor edits `points` (plants placed by hand) and `exclude` (places where a project's rules plant nothing); any other section is the project's own. The plan's frame: metres, +X east, +Z south; positions [x, z]; a rotation is DEGREES about Y.

points.description: plants placed by hand, one each

district.description: a note: which part of the map

rot.description: degrees about Y; left out: the project chooses

exclude.description: places where a project's rules plant nothing; points are not affected
